name: WCORR-EVAS-001: sudo → audit configuration change → audit daemon stopped
description: Detects sudo activity followed by an audit configuration change and an audit daemon stop event.
query:
sequence by agent.id.keyword with maxspan=20m
  [any where rule.id.keyword in ("5402", "5407")]
  [any where rule.id.keyword == "80705"
    and data.audit.type.keyword == "CONFIG_CHANGE"]
  [any where rule.id.keyword == "80703"]
author: Wazuh EQL Correlation
false_positives: Legitimate audit-service maintenance can match this potentially significant defence-evasion sequence.
setup: Collect sudo plus audit CONFIG_CHANGE and daemon-stop alerts; ensure audit telemetry is available.
